testCases.label: Validates successful table creation
testCases.description: Test that the table exists by attempting to insert a row into the table. If table does not exist, the test will fail.

testCases.label: Validates successful primary key constraint creation
testCases.description: Test that the primary key condition exists by attempting to insert 2 records with the same primary key value. If the primary key constraint does not exist, the test will fail.
